metadata.renderer: Vulkan
metadata.source_notifications: bounded coalesced wakeup; no packet polling
metadata.stream_flow_control: one in-flight packet; acknowledgement after receiver decode and latest-mailbox publication
metadata.update_strategy: authoritative full-window replacement in append and replace; no decimation; one Canvas per waveform plot with one path per curve; iced_runtime::image::allocate for every image plot before adopting a frame; retain the last ready Allocations until replacement; one active preparation/allocation plus one latest CPU packet; stale-generation allocation completions discarded

definitions.submitted_hz: measured submitted updates / fixed measured seconds
definitions.update_ms: frontend-specific synchronous update boundary; consult each adapter metadata
definitions.draw_ms: optional observed draw work; may overlap update_ms; missing is not zero
definitions.update_complete_ms: adapter preparation through its completion signal, including asynchronous wait; not displayed latency
definitions.image_upload_wait_ms: Iced allocation task through completion notification; includes scheduling, not pure GPU time
definitions.timing_coverage_percent: samples with a finite nonnegative stage observation / measured submissions; not displayed-frame coverage
definitions.gap_percent: missing sequence IDs / observed sequence span, excluding unobserved leading/trailing gaps
definitions.cpu_percent: sum across frontend process tree; 100% equals one logical CPU
definitions.source_hz: source frames produced during the frontend's measured interval
definitions.delivery_ack_hz: decoded-frame ACK counter increase / leading single-client source counter span inside the measured window (trailing samples after the client disconnected are excluded); unavailable with other client counts; not presentation and not exactly the full measurement window
definitions.completion_latency_seconds: browser runs: seconds from the nominal end of the run to the page's flushed completion signal; teardown work, not plotting or presentation
definitions.source_generation_p95_ms: p95 generation/packing/enqueue duration; consult backend implementation
definitions.source_mailbox_drops: produced frames replaced in the server mailbox while delivery awaited ACK
definitions.source_deadline_misses: increase in cumulative missed-deadline counter between first and last source sample in the measured window; boundary misses may be unobserved
definitions.submissions_per_bin: stability diagnostics: submitted samples per one-second bin after warmup, zero bins included; not displayed FPS
definitions.rss_mib: stability diagnostics: resident memory of the frontend process tree per resource observation inside the measured window; missing observations remain missing
